Package org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker

Class ChoiceSection

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker.Section
org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker.ChoiceSection
public final class ChoiceSection extends Section
A rail section of checkboxes over the distinct values of one dictionary column of a data source.

Publishes {schemaVersion:1, viewId, columns:{<dim>: [selected...]}, options:{deselected:[...]}}, omitting columns and options when every value is selected. The deselected list names the values the user has unticked (capped at max), so a reload can list them again and tick them back. The array value is a data-source extension: datatables do not apply it.

Unticking every value publishes an empty list (columns:{<dim>: []}). The data sources map an empty list to no restriction on the dimension, so "nothing ticked" shows every row, the same as "everything ticked". The section shows a "Select all" button while a filter is in force.

Example:

ChoiceSection.fromDim("orders", "reason").label("Reason").max(50) .publishes(Topics.filter("reasons"));

Since:
10.0.0
